QuestionStmt.S: Identify false statement from the following about fluorine.

Option3Stmt.S: It has high bond dissociation enthalpy among all halogens.

Solution.S: Fluorine is the most electronegative element (Option A is true). It exhibits only -1 oxidation state due to its small size and high electronegativity (Option B is true). Among halogens, chlorine (Cl₂) has the highest bond dissociation enthalpy, not fluorine, because fluorine has very small atomic size leading to high electron-electron repulsion in its bond (Option C is false). Fluorine forms only one oxoacid, HOF (hypofluorous acid), which is unstable (Option D is true). Therefore, the false statement is C.
